display_long_description:
🐒 Golilus VR

Welcome to Golilus VR, the ultimate place to swing, climb, and absolutely wreak havoc in VR with your friends! Explore the Forest, where trees are taller than your patience and every branch is a potential disaster waiting to happen. Or hit the Beach, where you can race your pals, dodge surprise coconuts, or just flail dramatically in the sand. Don’t forget the Shop, where you can buy weird, funny, or completely unnecessary items—because why not?

Whether you’re a master climber, a beach bum, or a chaos enthusiast, Golilus VR has something for you. Play solo, team up, or prank your friends in endless ways. Jump, swing, climb, and fall in ways that defy physics… or at least make you question your VR skills. Every session is different, every mishap hilarious, and every laugh guaranteed.

So grab your headset, forget about gravity, and prepare for the most ridiculous, fun, and slightly chaotic VR adventure you’ll ever have. Golilus VR: where friends become rivals, trees are taller than dreams, and the beach is always… suspiciously lively.
